data.name: Kallistrate
data.gender_notes: Kallistrate is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Kalos, meaning 'beautiful, handsome, or fine'. The suffix -strate means 'ruler or governor'. Kallistrate, therefore, translates to 'beautiful ruler'. The name Kallistrate carries the meaning “Beautiful, pure one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kallistrate usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, pure one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner beauty and leadership.
data.etymology: Kallistrate belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, pure one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kallistrate total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קאליסטרט
in_hebrew.meaning: השם קאליסטרט פירושו שייפה או יפה תואר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאליסטרט מקורו ביוונית ופירושו שייפה או יפה תואר. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'קאלוס' שפירושו יפה או תואר, ו-'סטרטוס' שפירושו צבא או שורות. בקונטקסט הנוצרי, השם קאליסטרט מייצג יופי פנימי ורוחני, והוא משויך לאלה שמחפשים את היופי והטוב שבאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Καλλιστράτη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καλλιστράτη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό και σημαίνει ωραία ή καλοκατάσκευη. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'κάλους' που σημαίνει ωραίος ή όμορφος, και 'στρατός' που σημαίνει στρατός ή σειρά. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα Καλλιστράτη αντιπροσωπεύει την εσωτερική και πνευματική ομορφιά, και συνδέεται με εκείνους που αναζητούν την ομορφιά και την καλοσύνη του Θεού.

data.cultural_impact: Kallistrate was a common name during the Byzantine era, where the Greek influence shaped the culture and society of the Eastern Roman Empire. The name carried a sense of prestige and power, indicating a ruler of great beauty and charm. This was a time when leaders were expected to possess both physical and moral beauty, making Kallistrate an appropriate name for someone in the royal court.
data.spiritual_significance: For early Christians, the name Kallistrate held a deeper spiritual significance. The name was believed to invoke the protective presence of Saint Kallisthenes, the patron saint of physicians, healers, and doctors. Kallistrates were believed to carry the virtues of this saint, including wisdom, courage, and healing powers. Thus, the name Kallistrate was a mark of divine blessing and favor, inspiring its bearer with a sense of responsibility and purpose.
